info.title: Pricing Day API
info.description: This API provides data regarding the price changes of popular products in Russia, impacted by the ongoing conflict initiated by Putin against Ukraine. It allows users to track and visualize the growth in prices, demonstrating the economic effects of aggressive political actions.

get.description: Retrieves the catalog of popular products with their pricing information showing the impact of economic conditions on prices in Russia.

200.description: Successfully retrieved product catalog with pricing data

CatalogResponse.description: Response containing product catalog with pricing information

pageProps.description: Page properties containing the catalog data

__N_SSG.description: Indicates if the page was statically generated

error.description: Error message describing what went wrong

tags.name: Catalog
tags.description: Operations related to retrieving product catalog and pricing data
